scope: Effective DC wire R and R*i^2 sensitivities, native endpoint coordinate/paint ownership and actual polygon/via paths. Reduced resistor edges are not asserted to be straight or assigned a unique material. Transient C/current sharing still matters; original failed gates remain.
engineering_findings: Driver/gain/termination bindings come from native terminal identity and actual probe ownership, not logical labels.
For gain59/60/111/112, driver-to-gain wire R is 39.4420808523,49.0568879776,39.6220808523,49.2368879776 ohms. Driver-to-termination is 44.5205154813/47.2683 ohms for both C and D.

Dominant upstream access records are 17.478 to22.5891 ohms; termination access records24.6792 to24.7407 ohms; path toward sampler10.7648 to17.0547 ohms; sampler base escape7.35954 ohms. These are metal/via-network values; intrinsic HBT/rppd devices were excluded from the diagnostic solve and remain unchanged in the circuit.
Raw reduced-resistor endpoint coordinates were located in actual same-net native material. A reduced resistor edge is not asserted to be a straight segment or one unique material.

Actual upstream paths rise through original retime M4 columns to M5 buses. Candidate next repair is physical upper-metal parallel accesses and actual via landings, with foreign-metal clearance and no device, bias or gate changes; this receipt does not accept that unbuilt candidate.
